templates.title: Nightlio
templates.name: nightlio
templates.description: Nightlio is a privacy-first mood tracker and daily journal designed for effortless self-hosting. Log your daily mood on a simple five-point scale, write rich Markdown journal entries with customizable tags, and view insightful analytics including mood history calendars, average mood trends, and journaling streaks. All data is stored in a local SQLite database on your own server with no telemetry, ads, or subscriptions.
templates.note: Privacy-first mood tracker and daily journal

env.name: SECRET_KEY
env.label: SECRET_KEY
env.description: Secret key used by the API for session signing. Change to a long random string

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: JWT_SECRET
env.description: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens. Change to a different long random string

env.name: CORS_ORIGINS
env.label: CORS_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the API directly. Add your public domain when exposing the app

env.name: ENABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH
env.label: ENABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH
env.description: Enables Google OAuth for multi-user support (1 to enable, 0 to disable)

env.name: ENABLE_MOOD_MUSIC
env.label: ENABLE_MOOD_MUSIC
env.description: Enables the mood music feature powered by Jamendo (1 to enable, 0 to disable)

env.name: DEFAULT_SELF_HOST_ID
env.label: DEFAULT_SELF_HOST_ID
env.description: Identifier of the default single-user account in self-hosted mode
